text: {"question":"How did the reported constraints on additional free‑streaming radiation evolve between the earlier and later studies?","reference_answer":"The earlier work treated the extra radiation as a single parameter \u2206N_{\rm eff} with a flat prior 0–1, while the later study split the contribution into free‑streaming and fluid‑like components (\u2206N_{\rm fs} and \u2206N_{\rm fld}), presenting separate constraints on each and fixing the standard neutrino value to 3.044."}
